ms.report:
Hi Team,
Please find in the link below, the Google Doc detailing the evidence of milestone completion of M2:
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/12qIh6jtRxivO1Q64nqY0yickVCouLnviIHV1v_q9hFA/edit?usp=sharing

Furthermore, following the 2nd reviewer's request to be provided with more descriptive information about the following items, please find below links to the precise code line numbers where those activities are performed:
・Authentication and Authorization (JWT Token):

https://github.com/cardanobi/cardanobi-python/blob/master/utils/api_client.py#L28
Explanation: the getAccessToken function request a Bearen Token (JWT Token) to the CardanoBI Identity base urls as defined here: https://github.com/cardanobi/cardanobi-python/blob/master/utils/constants.py , to complete this request it issues a POST request and passes the auth token (which is the concatenation of the user's API Key and Secret.
・Rest API Connectivity to allow the SDK to reach the CardanoBI API Instances:

https://github.com/cardanobi/cardanobi-python/blob/master/utils/api_client.py#L42
Explanation: the getRequest function prepares the headers of the request to include the Bearer Token prepared by getAccessToken, then is performs a GET against the CardanoBI endpoints base urls as defined here: https://github.com/cardanobi/cardanobi-python/blob/master/utils/constants.py
・Logical processing units: 

All processing units can be found in 2 files:
https://github.com/cardanobi/cardanobi-python/blob/master/domains/core.py
https://github.com/cardanobi/cardanobi-python/blob/master/domains/bi.py
In these files you'll find all the functions / processing units that actually perform the REST call to each CardanoBI API endpoints.

Hope this helps.
Best,

Thomas
